metadata.title: A flux-level Lyman-alpha forest test of a crossing-speed joint between an acceleration law and cold dark energy: frozen criteria and result (lane FRZ6, 2026-11-13)
metadata.description: Frozen criteria, committed before any script or number, for a test of a candidate rule against the DESI DR1 one-dimensional Lyman-alpha flux power spectrum. The candidate rule lets the acceleration law's layout hold only inside a settled radius and only in haloes slower than a crossing speed fixed by the law and the cosmic baryon share. The constants kappa = 1/2 and 5.41 are fitted, the rule is not adopted, and nothing here says the data favour the framework. Version 2 adds the result (FRZ6_RESULT.md: the labels as frozen first, then under a dated post hoc amendment), with the amendment, scripts, part files and graded outputs. Any label that holds is a hit awaiting an independent blind re-grade, not a pass.
